acceptanceCriteria: EMFILE/ENFILE during pool acquire (and other tasks commands sharing the error mapping) returns a distinct code (e.g. RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) with retryable true, never MALFORMED; the code is registered and specified as a proposed requirement pending owner acceptance.
A regression test injects EMFILE and ENFILE and asserts the code, retryable true, and no mutation.
Decide (spec) whether the CLI raises its soft RLIMIT_NOFILE toward the hard limit at startup; if adopted, test it and bound it.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#769 (filed 2026-10-11 by the owner). `corvint-tasks pool acquire` returned outcome ERROR, codes [MALFORMED], retryable false, warning 'too many open files in system' for three concurrent well-formed acquires during a host file-handle spike (macOS soft maxfiles 256). Callers treat MALFORMED/non-retryable as a bad request and stop; three agent sessions ended without work. Expected: a distinct resource-exhaustion code with retryable true; optionally raise the soft RLIMIT_NOFILE at startup. Related completed: V1-0841 (Darwin change guard descriptor exhaustion). Version: corvint-tasks build 407.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#795 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/795; landed by batch PR #795); on main at 8b659142492966161ca82d1f5ff8f503fec1c504 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/795). Tests named in the PR: pool acquire EMFILE retryable classification tests (PR #788 content). Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.
